stage: the campaign module folder mapping was wrong, so the campaign scope counted nothing
defect: CampaignModulePrefixes built 'content/modules/{moduleId}/' from the manifest id, but the manifest uses DOTS (urman.chapter1) while the directory uses HYPHENS (urman-chapter1). The prefix therefore never existed, and the campaign-scoped coverage report silently counted zero rules - the very scope the earlier review asked me to make honest
found_by: the new trial-run plan asked whether the module directories exist, which is the check the coverage projection never made
fix: one shared helper RuleCatalogCoverage.ModuleFolder(id) = id.Replace('.', '-'), used by both the coverage prefixes and the trial-run plan, so the convention is written once

verified.before_after: the check log records that the dotted path does not exist and the hyphenated one does, for all three modules
verified.probe: PASS 483/483; the campaign scope now really counts the rules its own modules author instead of reporting zero, and the stale invariant that asserted zero was replaced
